chat.thebrokenscript.fever.entry.message: <Fever> The night sky is beautiful, isn’t it?

chat.thebrokenscript.fever.msg.what: <Fever> This? This is a safe haven. You don't need to be afraid here.
chat.thebrokenscript.fever.msg.where: <Fever> Isn't it much more intriguing to think about where you aren't?
chat.thebrokenscript.fever.msg.who: <Fever> Don't fret, I am your Savior.
chat.thebrokenscript.fever.random.messag: <Fever> Do you have a voice in your heart?
<Fever> Do not be afraid, For you have found favor with God.
<Fever> Close your eyes and look at me.
<Fever> The less visible something is, the more beautiful it becomes.
<Fever> Do you know who you are?
<Fever> Does this world bring you solace?
<Fever> What do you seek from here?
<Fever> Why do you look for the living among the dead?
